payload.summary: Operator-authorized implementation-review round 4 reached final external quorum 0/5 and did not converge. Four premium CLI routes timed out at the bounded vendor deadline and Pi exhausted its schema-invalid recovery chain. Independent source verification found nine critical contract and recovery blockers, including a still-accepted false-zero consensus report.
completed_work: Dispatched the approved whole-branch diff to Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and Pi with 300-second vendor-local bounds.
Persisted and validated five terminal attempt chains in a versioned final manifest with stable quorum_requested=5; quorum_received=0.
Ran 232 focused review-hardening tests, the skill install portability check, schema parity checks, and git diff checks successfully.
Produced a schema-valid source-audited review with nine critical findings at reviews/round-4/review-findings.json.
in_progress: Operator action is required because the extra implementation-review cycle and configured cap are exhausted.

decisions.title: Return max_iter
decisions.rationale: This is the fourth and final authorized implementation-review round; external quorum was lost and source-verified merge blockers remain.

decisions.title: Keep validation and PR submission blocked
decisions.rationale: No implementation-review waiver was granted, and green focused tests do not refute the reproduced trust-boundary failures.

next_steps: Treat reviews/round-4/review-findings.json as the merge-blocking remediation set.
Do not advance to validation or PR submission without a new operator-authorized remediation cycle and a converged implementation review.
